reference_text: 我们以证据连接人的判断与智能体的行动。规范保存正式接受的意图，证据记录实际发生的事。看清关系，决定下一步；条件改变，就重新判断。
scope: Clear in-context reference derived from the approved synthetic narrator identity root, which stays unchanged. Its speaker embedding alone spoke reference text b; that rendition, with every inner silence capped at 0.12 s, spoke reference text a in context; this rendition, with every inner silence capped at 0.12 s, is the reference. Voiced audio is native model output: never time-stretched, pitch-shifted or recast. Pronunciation and listening quality are qualified separately from this input binding.

steps.text: 一份数据做完了，可下一位用它的人，能靠它做判断吗？他们需要知道每个数字是什么意思，对应哪个时间，依据从哪里来，能用在什么地方。
